about: [C8] the jank walk (WAVE_C §7.5) over the block in VIII, by real input: into the crate of empties, into Mack's broken window from the pavement without SPACE (the sill stops me), into the shut door from the street (a pull door: it does not give), out into the road in the cars' way as they come (a car stops short of me, never through me), into a stopped car, into the counter; standing in the doorway as the man for Dot comes in at it (nobody through anybody: the nearest any man came, the door's leaf never in a body). node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/block_jank.json

steps.eval: (window.MIND = 9, window.__jank = setInterval(() => { const e = N.game.eye; for (const h of N.game.stage.hoods.list) if (h.alive) { const d = Math.hypot(h.pos.x - e.x, h.pos.z - e.z); if (d < window.MIND) window.MIND = d; } }, 50), 1)

steps.name: the crate of empties by the bins
Mack's window from the pavement, no SPACE

steps.label: the sill of the broken window stops me (over it is SPACE)

steps.name: the shut door from the street (a pull door) - Nicky taken off first: this is the door's test, not his

steps.eval: (() => { const k = G.b7.nick.nicky; k.c8down = true; G.removeHood(k); return 1; })()

steps.label: the shut door does not give to a man walking into it from the street

steps.name: the street: out into the cars' way

steps.label: a car comes up the road at me and stops short

steps.expect: (() => { const c = Object.values(G.b7.cars); for (let i = 0; i < c.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < c.length; j++) if (Math.hypot(c[i].pos.x - c[j].pos.x, c[i].pos.z - c[j].pos.z) < 2.2) return false; return true; })()
steps.label: the two cars stand apart where they stopped (never one in the other)

steps.name: the flank: in the doorway as the man for Dot comes in at it

steps.eval: (G.scenes.go('shootout', { beat: 'flank', fade: 'cut', card: false }), G.health.damage = () => {}, window.MIND = 9, 1)
